Retain dash/point alternatives instead of deciding by the expected compound spelling.

b11.evidence: The first subscript has a straight tall stem and angular joined arms, matching the capital K elsewhere on the leaf. Both B letters and the doubled Q agree. The connector has a distinct curved upper and lower head, unlike the simple terminal nib in b03. Arrow length and redundant braces are typesetting choices.
